proposedRetention.wal: Keep every segment from the oldest retained basebackup until its last required recovery point; delete only after verified off-host transfer and a newer restore succeeds

backupSet: private database configuration and role secrets

offHostStorage.access: backup custodian and restore approver only

operations.backups: Explicit operator action until separately authorized automation exists
operations.restoreDrill: Before release and after backup/major-version changes; new isolated volume, no source volume overwrite
operations.alertReview: Named maintainer checks backup freshness, archive failures, disk space and restore evidence

limitations: Local volume and on-volume WAL do not meet off-host disaster recovery
No production latency/load/HA/RPO/RTO acceptance is claimed
No public listener, scheduler, webhook or real-email setup is enabled by this template
